Dormant unattempted tasks can be edited or reparented by tools/commands with expectedUpdatedAt. Active, completed and attempted task records stay immutable. Editing disarms the task; explicitly start it again after reviewing the new graph. Select a dormant task and choose Edit task to update its title, prompt and prerequisites. Save changes writes the graph atomically and disarms the task. If someone else changes it, cancel and reopen Edit task to review the current version.

guidance: A completed run without task-matching evidence is needs_review with the rejection reason; its folder lock is released, its dependents stay waiting.

completionEvidence is the author-declared acceptance contract. file: path, optional contains/sha256/condition; commit: paths and optional hash/condition; receipt: path and expected top-level tool/result fields under expect (tool is required); result: read-only observer condition.

For launched file/receipt work, capture the declared output hash before dispatch and require new bytes. Commits must descend from the pre-attempt HEAD and change the declared paths. A receipt must be changed, successful, match expect, and equal the workspace saved native receipt with a valid receiptHash. Its timestamp and successful transcript tool call must belong to this attempt.

Stated results require nonempty assistant output from this attempt and a grounded read-only CL condition the verifier accepts. run evidence is accepted only with a nested verified output witness. Completion alone, old files, unrelated paths and failed observers cannot tick Done.
